description: United_States_Naming_Customs, for the Flynn identity-conflict tests whose records are Pennsylvania-side and which now reach conflict-resolution's unconditional pre-work block (issue #2254). Content excerpted verbatim from the live page on 2026-09-23 (8,016 chars, most of it navigation). The page is deliberately reproduced as what it actually is - a hub of links to variant-spelling and nickname aids, carrying NO naming-system rule. That is the correct and useful answer for a US record set: there is no patronymic or two-surname system to apply, so a surname difference there carries none of the implication it would in a live patronymic jurisdiction. A fixture that invented a US 'system' would teach the skill the opposite of what the page says.
